title: TradingMoE: Routing the Right Experts in Evolving Markets
abstract: arXiv:2608.11785v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for financial analysis and trading, but direct trading remains challenging because the predictive capabilities required can vary across assets, decision fields, and market conditions. Existing LLM-based trading systems either coordinate human-defined external experts or adopt conventional internal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routers that do not directly evaluate how individual experts contribute to trading decisions. Moreover, these routers receive no direct signal indicating when an inactive expert has become more suitable as market conditions change. We find that native router scores poorly reflect how much individual experts improve trading decisions, frequently leaving better alternatives unselected. translated_title: 交易MoE：在演变市场中路由正确的专家
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在金融分析和交易方面显示出强大潜力，但直接交易仍然具有挑战性，因为所需的预测能力可能因资产、决策领域和市场条件而异。现有的基于LLM的交易系统要么协调人工定义的外部专家，要么采用传统的内部专家混合（MoE）路由器，这些路由器不直接评估各个专家对交易决策的贡献。此外，这些路由器没有接收到直接信号，指示当市场条件变化时，一个不活跃的专家何时变得更合适。我们发现，原生路由器的分数不能很好地反映单个专家对交易决策的改进程度，经常留下更好的替代方案未被选择。我们进一步揭示，特定于令牌的专家有用性表现出紧凑的低维结构。基于这些发现，我们提出了TradingMoE，一种面向交易的稀疏MoE，旨在解决这些问题。
tldr: 本文提出TradingMoE，一种面向交易的稀疏专家混合模型，通过揭示专家有用性的低维结构并改进路由机制，以应对市场变化中专家选择的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TradingMoE, a trading-oriented sparse Mixture-of-Experts model that improves router selection by uncovering the low-dimensional structure of expert usefulness, addressing challenges in expert routing under evolving market conditions.
